sources.title: Sabey Data Centers: Going Vertical milestone at SDC Umatilla
sources.summary: Sabey announced on 22 July 2026 that it held a Going Vertical ceremony on 15 July to celebrate the first steel rising at SDC Umatilla, its new data centre campus in Northeast Oregon. The release says the project moved from planning, engineering and site preparation into the vertical phase of development, with hundreds of skilled tradespeople expected over the coming months; National Real Estate Advisors is quoted as an investor.
sources.date_semantics: The release is dated 22 July 2026 (JSON-LD datePublished 2026-07-22T08:09:00-07:00, dateModified 08:09:38 the same day) and reports a ceremony held on 15 July. The 15 July event day falls 96 days before this update; the status is recorded at the 22 July release date as a publication-normalized observation, as in earlier updates, and is not an inspection day.
